summary: This Form 8-K reports the unregistered sale of 585,012.268 shares of common stock for ~$11.7 million (a continuous offering up to $4.5 billion), a regular monthly distribution declaration, and net asset value as of May 31, 2026. These are routine operational and capital-raising activities for a BDC, not a special situation. The sale is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural changes are mentioned. There is no M&A, activist, restructuring, or similar event; thus, no risk-arb angle.
